name: Referral source follow-up
summary: The day after a partner meets someone who sends the firm work, they have a follow-up draft and a list of every promise made at the table, by both sides. The draft uses only approved materials and nothing said in confidence; the partner checks it, chooses the next step and sends it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of law-firm work: keeping the promises made to a referral contact, with who starts it, what goes in, what comes out and who decides.
